name: php.switch_site
description: Move one site from one PHP version to another: in only that site's nginx server blocks the FPM socket changes, then nginx -t and a reload; in cron, supervisor and systemd lines that name the site's root, the PHP binary (that version, or a bare php) becomes the new one, then supervisor and the changed units are reloaded. The host-wide php alternative is never touched. Every file is backed up under /var/backups/php-switch first, keeping mode and owner. A smoke check asks nginx on the host for the site (no 5xx) and reads the new FPM's log for errors; on any failure every file is put back. It refuses unless the root is a directory an enabled vhost serves with the old FPM and the new FPM is running, and does nothing for a site already moved.

root.description: The site's root, the directory above public/, such as /home/forge/example.com.

from.description: The PHP version the site runs on now.

to.description: The PHP version to move it to, already installed and running.

health_check: The helper puts every file back unless nginx -t, the reloads and the smoke check pass.
